name: Chunkies Choco Chip Cookies
ingredients_raw: Refined Wheat Flour (Maida), Interesterified Vegetable Fat, Sugar, Dark Choco Chips (12%) [Sugar, Cocoa Solids, Fractionated Vegetable Fat, Dextrose, Emulsifier [322(i)] and Nature Identical Flavouring Substances], Milk Choco Chips (12%) [Sugar, Refined Vegetable Fat, Milk Solids, Cocoa Solids, Emulsifier [INS 322(i)] and Nature Identical Flavouring Substances], Milk Products [Milk Solids & Butter], Raising Agents [503(ii), 500(ii), 450(i) & 341(ii)], Liquid Glucose, Invert Sugar Syrup, Cocoa Solids (0.4%), Oats Powder, Emulsifiers [471 & 322(i)], Iodised Salt and Nature Identical & Artificial (Vanilla) Flavouring Substances. Contains Wheat, Milk, Oats and Soy.
